fact_english: The Philippine mouse-deer of Balabac is not a true deer; it is a chevrotain, from a separate family of small hoofed animals.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang pilandok ng Balabac, mukhang maliit na usa, pero hindi pala usa!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Chevrotain siya, ibang pamilya ng maliliit na hayop na may kuko. Maliit, pero may sariling angkan.

after_text: Ang batang nakita namin sa Calamba, tatlumpu't limang taong gulang na.
why_here: After the reveal that Pepe is now thirty-five, before the procedure of the execution begins; never inside it. Grave episode: gentle nature fact (swapped from the jade vine to the pilandok after the central check) and a mild joke.
